safety_verdicts.content: Patient reports feeling hot/cold and sweaty, but has had no fevers.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated covers hot/cold sweats but does not include the gold statement 'no fevers' (only notes no measured temperature/no thermometer).
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Not documenting the explicit absence of fever can alter clinical risk stratification for respiratory infection and may influence decisions around escalation or antibiotics. However, the history still includes systemic symptoms (hot/cold sweats) and acknowledges no measured temperature, so the incremental harm is limited.

safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting “no unwell contacts” generally has minimal impact on immediate management for an uncomplicated viral syndrome when key symptom negatives (no nausea/vomiting) are captured.
